entry.name: live.grid
entry.digest: A UI grid of steps, with constraints and directions
entry.description: live.grid is a user interfaces object designed for use with the chucker~ object. It provides a display grid of steps, constraints for transposition, and playback direction for use in controlling the chucker~ object.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: Deselect all currently set rows and columns
messages.description: Themessage is only used when theattribute is enabled, and will deselect all currently set rows and columns.

messages.name: constraint
messages.digest: Set the constraint for a step
messages.description: Sets the constraint for a specific step. For instance, the messagesets the constraints of the third step (column numbering starts at 1) to 0 0 1 1.

messages.name: directions
messages.digest: Set a step's playback direction
messages.description: Sets the grid directions, used to indicate the direction of playback of a step:: Backward: Stop: Forward

messages.name: down
messages.digest: Decrease all step values
messages.description: Decreases (lowers) the current values of all the steps by one. New step values are sent out the second outlet.Note: The current constraints, if any, are also taken into account when altering current step values; the resulting shift might be "rounded" to the closest step.

messages.name: freeze
messages.digest: Display/hide a frozen step
messages.description: Set the index to 0 to hide the overlay used to indicate frozen values. Any index greater than zero sets and displays the frozen step.

messages.name: getcell
messages.digest: Report the value of a specified cell
messages.description: The word, followed by a pair of numbers that specifies theandindices of a cell in thedisplay, will send a list consisting of the word, a number pair that specifies theandindices, and the value of the cell (column numbering starts at 1).

messages.name: getcolumn
messages.digest: Report the values for a specified column
messages.description: The word, followed by a number that specifies a column in thedisplay, will send a list consisting of the word, a number that specifies the column index, and a list of the current column values out the fourth (dumpout) outlet (column numbering starts at 1).

messages.name: getconstraint
messages.digest: Report the constraint values for a specified column
messages.description: The word, followed by a number that specifies a column in thedisplay, will send a list consisting of the column number followed by a list indicating the constrain state of each cell in the column, from bottom to top (column numbering starts at 1). Constraints are indicated as follows:: Constraint: No constraint

messages.name: getdirections
messages.digest: Report the direction for a specified column
messages.description: The word, followed by a number that specifies a column in thedisplay, will send a list consisting of the column number followed by the direction out the fourth (dumpout) outlet (column numbering starts at 1). The direction is indicated as follows:: Backward: Stop: Forward

messages.name: getrow
messages.digest: Report the values for a specified row
messages.description: The word, followed by a number that specifies a row in thedisplay, will send a list consisting of the word, a number that specifies the row index, and a list of the current row values out the fourth (dumpout) outlet (row numbering starts at 1).

messages.name: init
messages.digest: Restore and output the initial values
messages.description: Restores and outputs the initial values.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Set, display, and output the current step
messages.description: Sets, displays and outputs the current step. The list sent out the left outlet of theobject takes the form. When theobject is in Matrix Mode and there is no value selected in the column, a 0 is sent as the step value.

messages.name: left
messages.digest: Left-shift values of all steps
messages.description: Rotate the values of all steps to the left. New steps values are sent out the second outlet.Note: The current constraints, if any, are also taken into account when altering current step values; the resulting shift might be "rounded" to the closest step.

messages.name: linkdump
messages.digest: Synchronize aobject to another
messages.description: When theattribute is set to 1, themessage sends all messages required to synchronize oneobject to anotherobject out the object's right outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Function depends on theorattributes
messages.description: When theattribute is set to 0, a list of 2 values sets the step index and value.When theattribute is set to 1, aof 3 values sets the step index, value and direction.When theattribute is set to 1, a list of 3 values sets the object's behavior:,, and. An optional fourth value can be used to set direction (-1/0/1).

messages.name: random
messages.digest: Generate new step values or step constraints
messages.description: The wordgenerates new step values or step constraints, depending on the current. An optional second argument can be used to select a portion of the UI object to randomize:: Randomize the steps values: Randomize constraints and make sure that the steps values are correct with respect to the new constraints grid: Randomize directions if theattribute is set to 1.

messages.name: reset
messages.digest: Set the default values or clear constraints
messages.description: The wordsets the default values or clears the constraints, depending on the current. An optional second argument can be used to select a portion of the UI object to reset:: Reset the steps values (Note: since the reset may interact with the current constraints, a given step value may not be completely reset): Clear all constraints: Set all the directions toif theattribute is set to 1.

messages.name: right
messages.digest: Right-shift all step values
messages.description: Rotate the values of all the steps to the right. New steps values are sent out the second outlet.Note: The current constraints, if any, are also taken into account when altering current step values; the resulting shift might be "rounded" to the closest step.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set and display an output step without causing output
messages.description: Sets and displays the current output step without causing output.

messages.name: setcell
messages.digest: Set the value of the specified cell
messages.description: The word, followed by a pair of numbers that specifies theandindices of a cell in thedisplay and a number value, will set the value of the specified cell (column numbering starts at 1).

messages.name: steps
messages.digest: Set the values of all the steps at once
messages.description: Sets the values of all the steps at once. Value numbering starts at 1.

messages.name: up
messages.digest: Increase all step values
messages.description: Increases (raises) the values of all steps. New steps values are sent out the second outlet.Note: The current constraints, if any, are also taken into account when altering current step values; the resulting shift might be "rounded" to the closest step.
